title: The Business Brief — Beyond Revenue

scenes.title: 01 Opening
scenes.speaker: Nora
scenes.line: Welcome to The Business Brief. Revenue tells us how much a company sells. Marcus, what should we examine next?

scenes.title: 02 Margins
scenes.speaker: Marcus
scenes.line: Start with operating margin: operating profit divided by revenue. Sales can rise while profitability weakens, if costs grow faster. Nora, what about cash?

scenes.title: 03 Cash flow
scenes.speaker: Nora
scenes.line: Operating cash flow shows cash generated or used by the business. Accounting profit and cash flow can differ, so compare both over time.

scenes.title: 04 Close
scenes.speaker: Marcus
scenes.line: Then read management's outlook and its assumptions. Revenue, margins, cash flow, and guidance belong together. That is your earnings checklist, here on Stocks.
